approach: Static recompilation of the guest x86 to C, compiled natively for x86-64, with a software NV2A push-buffer executor in place of the GPU
help: Reproducing the USB queue stall on another host
3D rendering: fixed-function batches and texture binding
notes: Boots the retail USA XBE, runs the title's own main loop, plays the attract video and streams the menu BGM. Static recompilation with a pinned xboxrecomp submodule; no emulator and no CPU interpreter. No 3D scene: the software push-buffer executor rasterises 2D UI only, because the title's single vertex program writes constant texture coordinates and no fixed-function batches are submitted. Input is not accepted: the pad enumerates and its reports are served, but the title never polls it. The DSP is a passthrough stub, so audio effects are absent. The MSVC 2022 path is documented but has never been run. Needs your own legally obtained USA Xbox disc; no game data is included.
